definitions.gloss: high atmospheric pressure; high-pressure system; anticyclone
definitions.explanation: A weather system characterized by higher atmospheric pressure than the surrounding area, generally bringing clear and stable weather. The opposite of 低気圧 (low pressure).

examples.japanese: {高気圧|こうきあつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われて→覆う：02020_oou⟧⟦{晴|は}れている→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧。
examples.english: It's sunny because a high-pressure system is covering the area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧{高気圧|こうきあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Hot days will continue due to the influence of the Pacific high-pressure system.

examples.japanese: {高気圧|こうきあつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{低気圧|ていきあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The weather changes significantly depending on the positioning of high and low pressure systems.

notes:
A fundamental weather term heard daily in Japanese weather forecasts. The opposite is ⟦{低気圧|ていきあつ}→低気圧：21712_teikiatsu⟧ (low pressure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高気圧|こうきあつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われる→覆う：02020_oou⟧ (to be covered by a high-pressure system)
- ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧{高気圧|こうきあつ} (Pacific high-pressure system)
- {高気圧|こうきあつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{張|は}り{出|だ}す (a high-pressure system extends)
- {移動性|いどうせい}{高気圧|こうきあつ} (migratory anticyclone)

USAGE:
⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧{高気圧|こうきあつ} is especially important in Japanese weather as it dominates summer weather patterns, bringing the characteristic hot and humid summer days. Understanding this term is key to following Japanese weather forecasts.
